northStar: Number of UFV students annually completing a field-validated or external-partner SkyGrid experience.

kpis.target: ≥150 in first full operating year; ≥300 annually by 2033.
Monitor first; do not force a target that encourages unsafe progression.
Baseline in 2027; target approved at Gate 3.

kpis.kpi: Serious safety events; reporting culture; critical cyber findings; regulatory compliance; system availability
kpis.target: Zero unresolved critical launch findings; zero knowingly unauthorized operations; PROPOSED mature availability ≥95%.

acceptance.criterion: Operational launch no later than Sep. 1, 2030; internal target acceptance Aug. 15.
Innovation & Simulation Node commissioned and integrated.
Participation pathways across ≥5 UFV academic/program areas.

Required controls/permissions for launch operations and no unresolved critical safety deficiency.
